placements.why: The existing strata list is empty for this repo, but this envelope's content — an E2E test explicitly built to reproduce a named production failure pattern (missing-id, ## heading, no id field) and check a pass/fail constraint against it — is an exact instance of the ratified taxonomy's 'Calibration' category (testing/verifying system behavior against known cases), not a fit for Opportunity/Strategy/Product/Architecture/Organization/Proof/Templates. Minting it standalone since a strata mint needs no parent minted first.
placements.title: The org validates system behavior by re-running known production failures as tests
placements.frame: What specific, real production failure mode is being reproduced here, and what constraint must the system now satisfy to close the loop on it?

placements.title: A known production defect becomes a standing crash-safety guarantee
placements.frame: Does this test still reproduce a specific, real production failure mode, and does its pass condition still require both no-crash behavior and a valid generated output?
placements.why: No narrative leaves exist yet in this graph. src-1 names the concrete production-observed defect this test targets (missing-id on a ## heading) and src-2 states the acceptance criterion that closes the loop (must not crash, must produce a valid slug) — the position pass already reads these as one unit: reproduction target plus passing condition for the same derive-id test. Together they name a subject future envelopes will keep feeding (more reproduced failure patterns, more crash-safety criteria for id/slug derivation), not a one-time fact, so this clears the narrative grain test rather than being logged as a bare proof point. No existing leaf or strata name is an exact or close fit beyond the newly minted Calibration category, so this is placed as a new leaf under it.
